verses.2: May the king rejoice in your greatness, and may many people be saved through your salvation.
verses.3: A temptation was given to his heart, and I closed his lips with a lock.
verses.4: May he be blessed with good blessings upon his head, and may he be covered with light.
verses.5: May they live, and may those who were given to them from you be granted eternal life.
verses.6: May his greatness be praised in your salvation. May blessings and protection be upon him.
verses.7: May blessings always surround him, and may his face be filled with joy.
verses.8: For the king trusts in Jehovah, and His mercy is upon him forever.
verses.9: Your hand will find all your enemies; your mouth will speak of your detestables.
verses.10: May it be lit like a torch at the time of your presence, O LORD. May fire consume them, and may fire eat them up.
verses.11: The fruits of the earth will die, and their seeds will be destroyed by human hands.
verses.12: For we have suffered a great loss from you. Think about it carefully before you act rashly.
verses.13: For they will be destroyed when you are among your people. They will be punished in front of their own faces.
verses.14: May the Lord be praised through your power; may your greatness be celebrated and honored.
